Cover image: Close-ups of seeds used in this study (Credit: Marina LaForgia)

This cover is provided by the authors of the article “Alternative seed trait strategies are linked to a trade-off between spatial and temporal dispersal” (https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2435.70404), which features in this issue. They estimated spatial and temporal dispersal probabilities for 60 native and non-native annual plants and linked them to extensive seed trait measurements. Their results provide empirical support for the spatial-temporal dispersal trade-off while revealing that multiple distinct trait combinations can achieve similar dispersal strategies, underscoring the need to move beyond seed mass to understand plant life-history strategies.
